title: Scaled dot-product attention with a mask
summary: Batched softmax(QK^T / sqrt(d_k)) V with an optional boolean mask, plus the causal mask that a decoder uses.

mutants.batched_transpose: Uses K.T, which reverses every axis of a batched K, not only the last two.
mutants.causal_includes_diagonal: Builds the causal mask with k=0, so each token also blocks itself and the first row has no allowed key.
mutants.mask_after_softmax: Sets the blocked weights to 0 after the softmax, so the rows do not sum to 1.
mutants.no_max_shift: Calls np.exp on the raw scores, so large scores overflow to infinity.
mutants.no_scale: Forgets to divide the scores by sqrt(d_k).
mutants.scale_by_dk: Divides the scores by d_k, not by sqrt(d_k).
